text:
julia: heads up — seeing spike in 504s + early EOFs on /v1/stream (hosted-inference-ap-south) for the last 45m. support ticket 5219. customers report streams cutting out mid-token. p50 looks fine, but p95/p99 timeouts up. anyone oncall?

ops-bot: ALERT: 504 rate +18% in ap-south streaming endpoint. sample traces: r-984a1b, r-984a1c. paged the oncall. :rotating_light:

samir: on it, grabbing traces. @julia can you paste a failing req id or sample curl from support?

julia: support provided req id r-984a1b. here's a minimal repro client they sent:

curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/stream -d '{"model":"rw-large","input":"<long prompt>","stream":true}'

client says stream cuts after ~3s and they get early EOF.

maria: pulled the trace: upstream returned 200 but connection reset by peer (EOF) during chunked transfer. envoy sidecar logs show connection drain + CLOSED_WHILE_STREAMING around same time. also saw pod HUP on node at 9843214400.

ken: we rolled a canary autoscaler tweak ~1h ago (reduce target when CPU<20%) and also pushed a quantization patch to rw-large-canary which caused memory spikes. autoscaler killed one pod mid-stream — possible root cause.

samir: confirming. kubectl events for pod rw-large-canary-7 show SIGTERM then container killed @ 9843214398. memory high before kill. matches timeline.

julia: so combo is autoscaler pod kill + envoy drain closing client connection -> early EOF. explains customer impact.

maria: short-term mitigation proposals:
- increase terminationGracePeriodSeconds to 60
- set sidecar drain strategy to wait-for-active-streams (temporary)
- bump autoscaler cooldown/minReplicas to avoid single-pod teardown

ken: I can push hotfix to ap-south now: set terminationGracePeriodSeconds=60 and autoscaler minReplicas=2 for 30m, and rollback the quantization canary on that fleet.

julia: :thumbsup: support-windows: notify CS with workaround: client-side reconnects/retries on early EOF, and advise small backoff. also suggest resume tokens if client supports them.

ops-bot: ACTION created incident I-984321 with owner @ken, sev=2. postmortem meeting booked in 2 days: https://cal.redwood/meet/pm-984321

samir: commands I used to triage:

kubectl get pods -n hosted -o wide | grep rw-large-canary
kubectl logs rw-large-canary-7 -c envoy --since=1h | grep CLOSED_WHILE_STREAMING

also checked NLB idle timeout (AWS default ~350s) — not a factor here (EOF after ~3s).

maria: postmortem action list (draft):
- root cause: autoscaler killed pod mid-stream due to memory spike from quantization canary + aggressive scale-down
- immediate mitigation: increase grace period, rollback canary, bump minReplicas, adjust autoscaler cool-down
- follow-up: implement streaming-aware drain in sidecar, have autoscaler respect active connection count, add per-pod metric streaming_clients, alert on early EOF rate
- owners: eng-runtime (samir + ken) and product (julia)
- due: 7 days

julia: deployed hotfix at 9843214505. error rates dropped to baseline by 9843214660. support outbound to affected customers sent. :white_check_mark:

ken: patch rolled out and verified. monitoring: https://dash.redwood/streams/ap-south?inc=984321

ops-bot: INCIDENT I-984321 status: mitigated. postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/I-984321. follow-ups assigned, closing thread.

samir: thanks all — I'll take lead on the postmortem writeup and coordinate owners.
